content: Glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1 RAs), such as liraglutide and semaglutide, have been linked to an increased risk of worsening diabetic retinopathy in certain clinical studies. It is important to closely monitor the progression of retinopathy in patients being treated with GLP-1 RAs, particularly in those who already have established diabetic retinopathy or in individuals experiencing rapid reductions in their HbA1c levels.
